mina: Quick check-in for launch week: final checklist for webinar + three launch posts. Need: trimmed KW list (top 6), a compact JSON-LD bundle for landing (Event + Speaker + HowTo snippet), internal-link heatmap (pillar -> landing), redirect rules that preserve UTMs and fragments, and inbound lead routing for the register CTA. Can we assign owners?

arjun: Ill take KW prioritization + anchor copy. Will reduce to 6 seed kws and map intent. Sheet: https://tiny.example/kw-seed-1787

becka: Ill own the JSON-LD and the internal-link heatmap. Initial thought: include a HowTo snippet for "How to join the webinar" to get the rich result. Will keep FAQ to one question.

seo-bot: crawl-scan: 5 pages with duplicate meta descriptions; 2 pages missing structured event data. report: https://tiny.example/scan1787

mina: Becka paste the JSON-LD you plan to drop (small one). Also, Arjun, paste anchor suggestions and routing for register CTA (sales vs SDR).

becka: JSON-LD draft (minimal):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar: Benchmarks & Serving Patterns","mainEntity":{"@type":"Event","name":"Benchmarks & Serving Patterns","startDate":"2026-03-26T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example/webinars/benchmarks-serving-patterns"},"performer":{"@type":"Person","name":"Maya Ortiz","sameAs":"https://linkedin.example/maya"}},"@graph":[{"@type":"HowTo","name":"How to join the webinar","step":[{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Register with your work email"},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Check confirmation and add to calendar"}]}]}
```

arjun: KW anchors: "inference latency" (pillar article), "serving LLMs at scale" (pillar), "per-token cost" (case study). Lead routing: register CTA should default to marketing automation (MA) form. If company size >250 or has enterprise email domain rule, route to Sales SDR queue via zap. UTMs: ?utm_source=post&utm_campaign=benchmarks_launch.

mina: Redirect examples (nginx): please preserve query and fragment:
```nginx
# preserve qs and fragments
rewrite ^/old-webinar-page/?$ /webinars/benchmarks-serving-patterns? permanent;
location = /resources/webinar { return 301 /webinars/benchmarks-serving-patterns; }
# example to keep original fragment (#register)
if ($request_uri ~ "^/legacy#(.*)$") { return 301 /webinars/benchmarks-serving-patterns#$1; }
```

becka: Link heatmap: add 3 contextual links from the pillar to landing within the first 600 words (anchors above) + 1 link from docs landing page. Add an inline CTA module at the end of the pillar for Register / Watch on-demand.

seo-bot: recommendation: add rel="canonical" on older entry pages pointing to the new landing after redirect, and include Event.status = "EventScheduled". HowTo may help with rich snippets; keep HowTo short to two steps.

mina: Timeline: Arjun - KW + anchor locked by 15:00, Becka - JSON-LD + heatmap by 16:00, redirects PR + smoke tests by 16:30, routing rules to ops by 17:00, final copy + meta by 18:00, QA pass 20:00 PT. Go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT.

arjun: I'll open KW PR and include the anchor copy variations for A/B.

becka: Adding unit tests for JSON-LD presence and HowTo validation. Also adding a short regression check to ensure title/meta unaffected by canonical rewrites.

mina: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping eng-infra for the reload window and drop PRs here. Thanks :sparkles:
